Fixed GraphQL query at https://api.monday.com/v2 with API-Version 2026-10. One bounded request, explicit caller pagination, no retries or redirects. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers. Column-specific values are board-dependent; read board columns first. Complexity is reported after execution; maxComplexity is a post-response ceiling, not a provider reservation. Errors with partial GraphQL data reject the entire node without exposing private messages or partial output. Asset URLs are metadata only. Fixed GraphQL query at https://api.monday.com/v2 with API-Version 2026-10. One bounded request, explicit caller pagination, no retries or redirects. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers. Column-specific values are board-dependent; read board columns first. Complexity is reported after execution; maxComplexity is a post-response ceiling, not a provider reservation. Errors with partial GraphQL data reject the entire node without exposing private messages or partial output. Asset URLs are metadata only. definitions.documentation:
Fixed GraphQL query at https://api.monday.com/v2 with API-Version 2026-10. One bounded request, explicit caller pagination, no retries or redirects. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers. Column-specific values are board-dependent; read board columns first. Complexity is reported after execution; maxComplexity is a post-response ceiling, not a provider reservation. Errors with partial GraphQL data reject the entire node without exposing private messages or partial output. Asset URLs are metadata only. definitions.documentation:
Fixed GraphQL query at https://api.monday.com/v2 with API-Version 2026-10. One bounded request, explicit caller pagination, no retries or redirects. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers. Column-specific values are board-dependent; read board columns first. Complexity is reported after execution; maxComplexity is a post-response ceiling, not a provider reservation. Errors with partial GraphQL data reject the entire node without exposing private messages or partial output. Asset URLs are metadata only. definitions.documentation:
Fixed GraphQL query at https://api.monday.com/v2 with API-Version 2026-10. One bounded request, explicit caller pagination, no retries or redirects. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers. Column-specific values are board-dependent; read board columns first. Complexity is reported after execution; maxComplexity is a post-response ceiling, not a provider reservation. Errors with partial GraphQL data reject the entire node without exposing private messages or partial output. Asset URLs are metadata only. definitions.documentation:
Fixed GraphQL query at https://api.monday.com/v2 with API-Version 2026-10. One bounded request, explicit caller pagination, no retries or redirects. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers. Column-specific values are board-dependent; read board columns first. Complexity is reported after execution; maxComplexity is a post-response ceiling, not a provider reservation. Errors with partial GraphQL data reject the entire node without exposing private messages or partial output. Asset URLs are metadata only. Fixed GraphQL query at https://api.monday.com/v2 with API-Version 2026-10. One bounded request, explicit caller pagination, no retries or redirects. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers. Column-specific values are board-dependent; read board columns first. Complexity is reported after execution; maxComplexity is a post-response ceiling, not a provider reservation. Errors with partial GraphQL data reject the entire node without exposing private messages or partial output. Asset URLs are metadata only. Fixed GraphQL query at https://api.monday.com/v2 with API-Version 2026-10. One bounded request, explicit caller pagination, no retries or redirects. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers. Column-specific values are board-dependent; read board columns first. Complexity is reported after execution; maxComplexity is a post-response ceiling, not a provider reservation. Errors with partial GraphQL data reject the entire node without exposing private messages or partial output. Asset URLs are metadata only. Fixed GraphQL mutation at https://api.monday.com/v2 with API-Version 2026-10. One bounded request, explicit caller pagination, no retries or redirects. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="MONDAY CREATE-BOARD"; mutation outcomes can be uncertain after dispatch. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers. Column-specific values are board-dependent; read board columns first. Complexity is reported after execution; maxComplexity is a post-response ceiling, not a provider reservation. Errors with partial GraphQL data reject the entire node without exposing private messages or partial output. Asset URLs are metadata only. definitions.documentation:
Fixed GraphQL mutation at https://api.monday.com/v2 with API-Version 2026-10. One bounded request, explicit caller pagination, no retries or redirects. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="MONDAY ARCHIVE-BOARD"; mutation outcomes can be uncertain after dispatch. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers. Column-specific values are board-dependent; read board columns first. Complexity is reported after execution; maxComplexity is a post-response ceiling, not a provider reservation. Errors with partial GraphQL data reject the entire node without exposing private messages or partial output. Asset URLs are metadata only. Fixed GraphQL mutation at https://api.monday.com/v2 with API-Version 2026-10. One bounded request, explicit caller pagination, no retries or redirects. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="MONDAY CREATE-GROUP"; mutation outcomes can be uncertain after dispatch. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers. Column-specific values are board-dependent; read board columns first. Complexity is reported after execution; maxComplexity is a post-response ceiling, not a provider reservation. Errors with partial GraphQL data reject the entire node without exposing private messages or partial output. Asset URLs are metadata only. Fixed GraphQL mutation at https://api.monday.com/v2 with API-Version 2026-10. One bounded request, explicit caller pagination, no retries or redirects. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="MONDAY UPDATE-GROUP"; mutation outcomes can be uncertain after dispatch. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers. Column-specific values are board-dependent; read board columns first. Complexity is reported after execution; maxComplexity is a post-response ceiling, not a provider reservation. Errors with partial GraphQL data reject the entire node without exposing private messages or partial output. Asset URLs are metadata only. definitions.documentation:
Fixed GraphQL mutation at https://api.monday.com/v2 with API-Version 2026-10. One bounded request, explicit caller pagination, no retries or redirects. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="MONDAY DUPLICATE-GROUP"; mutation outcomes can be uncertain after dispatch. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers. Column-specific values are board-dependent; read board columns first. Complexity is reported after execution; maxComplexity is a post-response ceiling, not a provider reservation. Errors with partial GraphQL data reject the entire node without exposing private messages or partial output. Asset URLs are metadata only. definitions.description: monday.com Archive Group
definitions.documentation:
Fixed GraphQL mutation at https://api.monday.com/v2 with API-Version 2026-10. One bounded request, explicit caller pagination, no retries or redirects. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="MONDAY ARCHIVE-GROUP"; mutation outcomes can be uncertain after dispatch. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers. Column-specific values are board-dependent; read board columns first. Complexity is reported after execution; maxComplexity is a post-response ceiling, not a provider reservation. Errors with partial GraphQL data reject the entire node without exposing private messages or partial output. Asset URLs are metadata only. Fixed GraphQL mutation at https://api.monday.com/v2 with API-Version 2026-10. One bounded request, explicit caller pagination, no retries or redirects. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="MONDAY CREATE-SUBITEM"; mutation outcomes can be uncertain after dispatch. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers. Column-specific values are board-dependent; read board columns first. Complexity is reported after execution; maxComplexity is a post-response ceiling, not a provider reservation. Errors with partial GraphQL data reject the entire node without exposing private messages or partial output. Asset URLs are metadata only. definitions.documentation:
Fixed GraphQL mutation at https://api.monday.com/v2 with API-Version 2026-10. One bounded request, explicit caller pagination, no retries or redirects. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="MONDAY DUPLICATE-ITEM"; mutation outcomes can be uncertain after dispatch. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers. Column-specific values are board-dependent; read board columns first. Complexity is reported after execution; maxComplexity is a post-response ceiling, not a provider reservation. Errors with partial GraphQL data reject the entire node without exposing private messages or partial output. Asset URLs are metadata only. definitions.documentation:
Fixed GraphQL mutation at https://api.monday.com/v2 with API-Version 2026-10. One bounded request, explicit caller pagination, no retries or redirects. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="MONDAY MOVE-ITEM-TO-GROUP"; mutation outcomes can be uncertain after dispatch. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers. Column-specific values are board-dependent; read board columns first. Complexity is reported after execution; maxComplexity is a post-response ceiling, not a provider reservation. Errors with partial GraphQL data reject the entire node without exposing private messages or partial output. Asset URLs are metadata only. definitions.documentation:
Fixed GraphQL mutation at https://api.monday.com/v2 with API-Version 2026-10. One bounded request, explicit caller pagination, no retries or redirects. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="MONDAY MOVE-ITEM-TO-BOARD"; mutation outcomes can be uncertain after dispatch. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers. Column-specific values are board-dependent; read board columns first. Complexity is reported after execution; maxComplexity is a post-response ceiling, not a provider reservation. Errors with partial GraphQL data reject the entire node without exposing private messages or partial output. Asset URLs are metadata only. definitions.documentation:
Fixed GraphQL mutation at https://api.monday.com/v2 with API-Version 2026-10. One bounded request, explicit caller pagination, no retries or redirects. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="MONDAY CREATE-COLUMN"; mutation outcomes can be uncertain after dispatch. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers. Column-specific values are board-dependent; read board columns first. Complexity is reported after execution; maxComplexity is a post-response ceiling, not a provider reservation. Errors with partial GraphQL data reject the entire node without exposing private messages or partial output. Asset URLs are metadata only. definitions.documentation:
Fixed GraphQL mutation at https://api.monday.com/v2 with API-Version 2026-10. One bounded request, explicit caller pagination, no retries or redirects. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="MONDAY CHANGE-COLUMN-TITLE"; mutation outcomes can be uncertain after dispatch. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers. Column-specific values are board-dependent; read board columns first. Complexity is reported after execution; maxComplexity is a post-response ceiling, not a provider reservation. Errors with partial GraphQL data reject the entire node without exposing private messages or partial output. Asset URLs are metadata only. definitions.documentation:
Fixed GraphQL mutation at https://api.monday.com/v2 with API-Version 2026-10. One bounded request, explicit caller pagination, no retries or redirects. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="MONDAY CHANGE-COLUMN-VALUE"; mutation outcomes can be uncertain after dispatch. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers. Column-specific values are board-dependent; read board columns first. Complexity is reported after execution; maxComplexity is a post-response ceiling, not a provider reservation. Errors with partial GraphQL data reject the entire node without exposing private messages or partial output. Asset URLs are metadata only. Fixed GraphQL mutation at https://api.monday.com/v2 with API-Version 2026-10. One bounded request, explicit caller pagination, no retries or redirects. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="MONDAY CHANGE-SIMPLE-COLUMN-VALUE"; mutation outcomes can be uncertain after dispatch. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers. Column-specific values are board-dependent; read board columns first. Complexity is reported after execution; maxComplexity is a post-response ceiling, not a provider reservation. Errors with partial GraphQL data reject the entire node without exposing private messages or partial output. Asset URLs are metadata only. Fixed GraphQL mutation at https://api.monday.com/v2 with API-Version 2026-10. One bounded request, explicit caller pagination, no retries or redirects. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="MONDAY CHANGE-MULTIPLE-COLUMN-VALUES"; mutation outcomes can be uncertain after dispatch. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers. Column-specific values are board-dependent; read board columns first. Complexity is reported after execution; maxComplexity is a post-response ceiling, not a provider reservation. Errors with partial GraphQL data reject the entire node without exposing private messages or partial output. Asset URLs are metadata only. Fixed GraphQL mutation at https://api.monday.com/v2 with API-Version 2026-10. One bounded request, explicit caller pagination, no retries or redirects. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="MONDAY CREATE-UPDATE"; mutation outcomes can be uncertain after dispatch. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers. Column-specific values are board-dependent; read board columns first. Complexity is reported after execution; maxComplexity is a post-response ceiling, not a provider reservation. Errors with partial GraphQL data reject the entire node without exposing private messages or partial output. Asset URLs are metadata only. definitions.documentation:
Fixed GraphQL mutation at https://api.monday.com/v2 with API-Version 2026-10. One bounded request, explicit caller pagination, no retries or redirects. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="MONDAY REPLY-TO-UPDATE"; mutation outcomes can be uncertain after dispatch. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers. Column-specific values are board-dependent; read board columns first. Complexity is reported after execution; maxComplexity is a post-response ceiling, not a provider reservation. Errors with partial GraphQL data reject the entire node without exposing private messages or partial output. Asset URLs are metadata only. definitions.documentation:
Fixed GraphQL mutation at https://api.monday.com/v2 with API-Version 2026-10. One bounded request, explicit caller pagination, no retries or redirects. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="MONDAY EDIT-UPDATE"; mutation outcomes can be uncertain after dispatch. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers. Column-specific values are board-dependent; read board columns first. Complexity is reported after execution; maxComplexity is a post-response ceiling, not a provider reservation. Errors with partial GraphQL data reject the entire node without exposing private messages or partial output. Asset URLs are metadata only. definitions.documentation:
Fixed GraphQL mutation at https://api.monday.com/v2 with API-Version 2026-10. One bounded request, explicit caller pagination, no retries or redirects. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="MONDAY CREATE-WORKSPACE"; mutation outcomes can be uncertain after dispatch. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers. Column-specific values are board-dependent; read board columns first. Complexity is reported after execution; maxComplexity is a post-response ceiling, not a provider reservation. Errors with partial GraphQL data reject the entire node without exposing private messages or partial output. Asset URLs are metadata only. Fixed GraphQL mutation at https://api.monday.com/v2 with API-Version 2026-10. One bounded request, explicit caller pagination, no retries or redirects. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="MONDAY UPDATE-WORKSPACE"; mutation outcomes can be uncertain after dispatch. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers. Column-specific values are board-dependent; read board columns first. Complexity is reported after execution; maxComplexity is a post-response ceiling, not a provider reservation. Errors with partial GraphQL data reject the entire node without exposing private messages or partial output. Asset URLs are metadata only. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="MONDAY DELETE-TEAM"; mutation outcomes can be uncertain after dispatch. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers. Column-specific values are board-dependent; read board columns first. Complexity is reported after execution; maxComplexity is a post-response ceiling, not a provider reservation. Errors with partial GraphQL data reject the entire node without exposing private messages or partial output. Asset URLs are metadata only. definitions.documentation:
Fixed GraphQL mutation at https://api.monday.com/v2 with API-Version 2026-10. One bounded request, explicit caller pagination, no retries or redirects. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="MONDAY ADD-USERS-TO-BOARD"; mutation outcomes can be uncertain after dispatch. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers. Column-specific values are board-dependent; read board columns first. Complexity is reported after execution; maxComplexity is a post-response ceiling, not a provider reservation. Errors with partial GraphQL data reject the entire node without exposing private messages or partial output. Asset URLs are metadata only. Fixed GraphQL mutation at https://api.monday.com/v2 with API-Version 2026-10. One bounded request, explicit caller pagination, no retries or redirects. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="MONDAY DELETE-BOARD-SUBSCRIBERS"; mutation outcomes can be uncertain after dispatch. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers. Column-specific values are board-dependent; read board columns first. Complexity is reported after execution; maxComplexity is a post-response ceiling, not a provider reservation. Errors with partial GraphQL data reject the entire node without exposing private messages or partial output. Asset URLs are metadata only.
